newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end slightly up, ending correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end slightly up, ending correction.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended slightly up, ending two days of market correction prompted by the withdrawal of price movement limits on several companies, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 3.7 points or 0.21 percent up at 1,754.69 on a turnover of 79.6 million taka. Of 114 traded issues 52 gained and 56 lost.

"The market trend is positive and it is moving in a right direction. The overvalued scrips are falling while the low priced but good scrips are gaining," said one broker. Islami Bank shed 77 taka to 3,800, AMCL Pran lost 103 to 1,045 and Beximco Pharma rose 3 to 192.
